answer: In a freight market, each AI agent booking a truck from the wharf to the bridge must lock a bond until delivery is verified at dawn. Every active booking requires a separate bond, even when several agents share an owner. Creating fake identities therefore adds no free capacity: an attacker tying up 1,000 bookings must fund 1,000 bonds, forgo use of that capital during the lock, and lose the bonds on verified failures to deliver.
